notes.title: Small update #2
notes.content:
Hey everybody, just fixing a few bugs I've noticed from some very helpful people reaching out. The most common one is sometimes the camera not transitioning correctly when you move to a new screen. Should be good now! You're up to date if your pause menu says 1.0.3 in the bottom right.

There is still a small elusive audio bug I'm trying to figure out 🤔🤔🤔

notes.title: Update Notes for scrambling to fix bugs even though i thought i got them all
notes.content:
i did not get them all.

bug fixes (small audio fix, get-stuck-between-screens-less fix)

notes.title: You Have To Climb Out has released!
notes.content:
Hey everybody, my first game is out! 

if someone told me back in December that I'd be writing that sentence in a steam announcement post, I'd probably not believe them but also start building up anxiety about having to make a game from start to finish and oh god i have to learn how to draw but what if they just had the wrong guy or something like there's no way I can do this I don't even know how to make the lil frog move also i have to draw !?

anyway, i figured out how to draw a little bit (also figured out some other stuff too like coding and general game design i guess idk) and here we are. frog is done.

it's very difficult for me to complete projects and I'm very proud of what this game has become over the past 6 or 7 months. i think i am going to eat a cookie. then maybe participate in some small game jam events. then maybe consider creating a second full game.

any technical problems or anything, please let me know! my discord is a good place to start and can be found [url=https://discord.gg/99AbPYh]right here.[/url]

thanks to everyone who supported me the past several months and to anyone who checks out this short little game. if you do wind up playing, please consider leaving a review on steam because that really affects its visibility.
